_comment: Stored default wording, used ONLY when prompt generation is unavailable or fails validation (FR-ENT-023). In normal use the model words every capture prompt (FR-ENT-022).

check_in.mood: How are you feeling right now?
check_in.triggers: Is anything in particular behind that? Pick any that fit.
check_in.trigger_note: Anything else you'd like to put down?
check_in.thinking_traps: Looking at what you wrote — did any of these fit how you were reading it?
check_in.feelings: Which feelings are here with you right now?
check_in.feeling_intensity: How strong is that, right now?
check_in.anxiety: How much stress or worry is with you right now?
check_in.energy: How is your energy right now?
check_in.feeling_ratings: How strong is each of those, right now?
check_in.sleep_hours: About how many hours did you sleep last night?
check_in.sleep_quality: And how well did you sleep?
check_in.intention: What's one thing you'd like to do, or keep in mind, today?
check_in.dread_triggers: Is anything about today on your mind that feels hard? Pick any that fit.
check_in.dread_note: Would you like to say a little about it?
check_in.activities: What has today held so far? Pick any that fit.
check_in.pleasure: How much have you enjoyed what you did today?
check_in.achievement: And how much have you got done that mattered to you?
check_in.stress_triggers: What was it about? Pick any that fit.
check_in.stress_note: Would you like to say a little about what happened?
check_in.coping: Did you use anything to help you cope? Pick any that fit.
check_in.day_rating: Looking back, how was today overall?
check_in.day_activities: What did today include? Pick any that fit.
check_in.plan_completed: Did today go roughly the way you hoped this morning?
check_in.what_helped: What helped today, even a little?
check_in.bothering_thoughts: Are any thoughts still bothering you tonight?
check_in.good_moment: Was there a good moment today you'd like to hold on to?
check_in.faced_avoidance: Did you face something today that you would usually avoid?
check_in.win: One small win, or something you're grateful for, if you like.
check_in.phq9_1: These next questions come once a week. Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you been bothered by the following? Little interest or pleasure in doing things
check_in.phq9_3: Trouble falling or staying asleep, or sleeping too much
check_in.phq9_4: Feeling tired or having little energy
check_in.phq9_6: Feeling bad about yourself — or that you are a failure or have let yourself or your family down
check_in.phq9_7: Trouble concentrating on things, such as reading the newspaper or watching television
check_in.phq9_8: Moving or speaking so slowly that other people could have noticed? Or the opposite — being so fidgety or restless that you have been moving around a lot more than usual
check_in.phq9_9: Thoughts that you would be better off dead or of hurting yourself in some way
check_in.gad7_1: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you been bothered by the following? Feeling nervous, anxious or on edge
check_in.gad7_2: Not being able to stop or control worrying
check_in.gad7_3: Worrying too much about different things
check_in.gad7_5: Being so restless that it is hard to sit still
check_in.gad7_7: Feeling afraid as if something awful might happen

free_write.account: This space is yours. Write whatever is on your mind.

offer: Thank you — your entry is saved. Would you like to talk it through a little, or stop here?
declined: Okay. Your entry is saved — take care of yourself.
saved: Your entry is saved. Please look after yourself — the people under Get help are there whenever you need them.

savouring.event: What's something good that happened recently — big or small?
savouring.significance: What made it matter to you?
savouring.feelings: Which feelings come up when you think about it?

savouring_close: Thank you for noticing this and keeping it. Take a slow breath and let the moment stay with you a little longer.

thought.name: What would you like to call this entry?
thought.situation: What was happening when the thought showed up?
thought.automatic_thought: What was the thought, in the words it came in?
thought.feelings: What did you feel in that moment?
thought.emotions_before: How strong was each of those feelings at the time?
thought.thinking_traps: Did any of these thinking patterns show up with it? Pick any that fit.
thought.supporting_evidence: What makes that thought feel true?
thought.contradicting_evidence: And is there anything that doesn't fit the thought?
thought.revised_thought: Knowing all that, how would you put the thought now?
thought.emotions_after: And how do those same feelings sit now?

exposure.feared_outcome: What are you afraid will happen?
exposure.distress_before: Thinking about it right now, how strong is the distress?
exposure.planned_activity: What will you do, and when?
exposure.post_account: You're back — how did it go?
exposure.distress_during: How strong was the distress while you were doing it?
exposure.distress_after: And how strong is it now?
exposure.learning: What do you take away from this?
